options.name: crawler_action
options.description: Select the action that FortiWeb takes when it detects a crawler Bot violation of the rule.

options.name: crawler_block_period
options.description: The number of seconds that you want to block subsequent requests from the client after the FortiWeb appliance detects that the client has violated the rule. Only available when 'crawler_action' is 'block-period'.

options.name: crawler_severity
options.description: Select which severity level the FortiWeb appliance will use when it logs a violation of the rule.

options.name: crawler_status
options.description: Enable or disable the crawler Bot check for this rule.

options.name: crawler_threat_weight
options.description: Set the weight for the threat.

options.name: crawler_trigger
options.description: Select which trigger, if any, that the FortiWeb appliance will use when it logs and/or sends an alert email about a violation of each rule.
